CREATE TABLE `fungal_item_operations` (
  `outcome_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `scope` tinyint(3) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `task_id` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `native_occurrence` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `activity_id` tinyint(3) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `accepted_time` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `recipient_character` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `source_token` binary(16) NOT NULL,
  `actor_entity` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `actor_spawn` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `actor_npc` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `source_identity` varbinary(4096) NOT NULL,
  `output_item` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `output_quantity` tinyint(3) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `output_serial` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `output_slot` smallint(6) NOT NULL,
  `output_charges` smallint(6) NOT NULL,
  `output_identity` varbinary(4096) NOT NULL,
  `native_ack` tinyint(3) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  PRIMARY KEY (`outcome_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `finite_native_operation` (`scope`,`task_id`,`native_occurrence`,`activity_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `source_token` (`source_token`),
  CONSTRAINT `fungal_finite_operation` CHECK (`scope` = 1 and `task_id` = 920141 and `activity_id` = 7 and `output_item` = 40997 and `output_quantity` = 1 and `actor_npc` = 481093 or `scope` = 2 and `task_id` = 920143 and `activity_id` = 5 and `output_item` = 43586 and `output_quantity` = 2 and `actor_npc` = 481093 or `scope` = 2 and `task_id` = 920143 and `activity_id` = 10 and `output_item` = 43587 and `output_quantity` = 1 and `actor_npc` = 481052),
  CONSTRAINT `fungal_positive_identity` CHECK (`native_occurrence` > 0 and `accepted_time` > 0 and `recipient_character` > 0 and `actor_entity` > 0 and `actor_spawn` > 0 and `output_serial` > 0),
  CONSTRAINT `fungal_ack` CHECK (`native_ack` in (0,1))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=latin1 COLLATE=latin1_swedish_ci
